 Decisive challenge on Sunday/ Coach Maran and Asllani: Victory and three points, the only objective against Belarus
 November 14, 2026 19:53 | -->
 Text size:
 National team coach Rolando Maran and midfielder Kristjan Asllani appeared at the official press conference at the "Illovszky Rudolf Stadion" stadium, on the eve of the final match in Group C1 in the UEFA Nations League against Belarus, which will be played tomorrow at 18:00.
 Coach Rolando Maran praised Belarus as a strong opponent, but stressed that the National Team is prepared and determined to give its best.
 The red and black coach said that the team will not make calculations, but will focus on its performance and achieving the final objective. Regarding the formation, Maran announced that the final decision will be made after evaluating the physical condition of the players.
 Will Ramadan's absence be felt and how is Muçi's condition? 
 – No, I'm not worried, because I have other players available. We are in the National Team and all the players we have in the team are at the right level to do well, so there is no reason to worry.
 On the contrary, this will be an opportunity for other players to show their worth and be useful to the team. Everyone wants to contribute and do something for this shirt, so it will be a good opportunity for them.
 As for Ernesto, he didn't train this morning. We'll assess him tomorrow and see how he feels.
 Belarus, what opponent do you expect tomorrow? 
 –We face an opponent that is probably the team we have had the most difficulty against in this group. In fact, in the last 12 matches, Belarus has lost only once and that loss was against us.
 This shows that we will face a team that is having a good moment and that it will be a difficult challenge to take control of the game and develop it the way we want.
 However, we are ready and determined. We have built an important identity as a team and we have players who are trying to give their best to achieve the result we need. We will take to the field with these qualities, which are our strengths and which we must show to the maximum when we play with this jersey, to achieve our objective.
 Will you be satisfied with a draw tomorrow, or will you go out on the field just to win? – No, absolutely not. We are a team that doesn't count. You will never see a team that goes out on the field saving energy or counting. We are a team that has to give its best in every match.
 These are players who, if they have this mentality, manage to give even more than is expected of them. We always try to surpass ourselves, to improve every day and in every match. This is our objective: to be better than in the last match, to achieve the result we are looking for, without thinking about anything else and without making absolutely no calculations.
 Will the fact that even a draw is enough to reach first place affect our approach? 
 – I am used to always telling the truth. In fact, this issue has never been discussed inside the dressing room or in our meetings. We have only thought about giving our best and doing everything to develop the best possible performance. We are focused on our performance and giving our best for this shirt.
 How have these two days been in terms of recovery, was there enough time to be ready? – It is clear that in these cases we work more through analysis than through training on the field. Today, during the training session, we tried to look at some situations, but more in a theoretical and explanatory aspect. I believe this applies to both us and the opponent.
 In such matches, we need to focus on certain situations that can be decisive and that can help us during the game. These are situations that we have analyzed and identified in previous matches, both ours and those against Belarus.
 The lineup, have you decided how you will play tomorrow? – No, when you play matches so close to each other, it is more difficult to have a lineup determined with certainty from the beginning. I have to first see the condition of the players tomorrow morning and then make the decision.
 Of course I have some ideas in mind, but I want to see how the players react during tomorrow morning's activation and what answers I get from their physical condition. Then I will make the final choice.
 Kristjan Asllani: Victory and three points, the only objective 
 Kristjan Asllani said that the National Team is in a very good moment and prepared for the challenge against Belarus, emphasizing that the only objective is to win and get three points. The midfielder praised the performance against Finland, while underlining that the team must play with character, aggression and courage. Asllani also spoke about the importance of the group, emphasizing that in the National Team everyone plays for Albania, while expressing satisfaction with his more advanced role in the midfield and the spaces he is creating to hit the goal.
 How is the situation of the team? 
 – The mood is very good, today we had the last session in the morning. We are well prepared, now we will also study the opposing team. Tomorrow we all know that it is a very important match for us. We should not think about what we need. We should only think about getting the three points. We will enter the field for victory.
 What will be the way to get the victory? 
 – Of course, we will enter the field with character and a lot of aggression. They are a very physical team. We saw it in Tirana, they put us in a lot of trouble, especially in the first half. But we are well prepared, we are in a good moment and we want to win the game.
 How much has the victory with Finland helped you? 
 – When you wear this shirt you have to give not 100%, but more. We need the maximum. I believe we played a very good match against Finland in front of our fans. We are very happy, but now we are only thinking about Belarus.
 You've played with Shehu before, do you think it will be a problem? 
 – No, not at all. It's not a problem. It happens in football. Ramadani has received a yellow card and will be absent, he won't be and we're sorry. But all the boys are ready. We all know that in the National Team we don't play for Asllani, Ramadani or Shehu, but because we all represent our nation, our families and we only think about Albania.
 Against Finland you were stopped by the goalkeeper, do you think you can improve your goal against Belarus? – I don't know, after the two goals against San Marino the fans are asking for more goals again. I'm not a striker, but I would really like to score. The important thing is to get three points and come out happy.
 Positive moment for the National Team, what are the reasons that influenced it? 
– We are daring a lot. The coach is asking us to be very aggressive. A football that is going very well. We are showing well on the field. In the first two games we did not understand it well, but now all the boys have understood it, the coach has understood us. We are all together and we are only thinking about tomorrow. We need the victory here too.
 We see a more advanced and dangerous Asllan, would you have missed this role? 
 – We are now playing with two midfielders. The coach wants rotations. I am the midfielder who gets the most out of the game. I have space and I am shooting at goal. I like the form we are going through now. I am very happy.
